title: Cyclically $5$-edge-connected snarks with resistance $2$ and flow resistance $n$
summary: Snarks are $2$-connected cubic graphs that do not admit a proper $3$-edge-coloring. For a cubic graph $G$, its resistance $r(G)$ is the minimum number of edges whose removal results in a $3$-edge-colorable graph, while its flow resistance $r_f(G)$ is the minimum number of edges whose removal results in a graph admitting a nowhere-zero $\mathbb{Z}_2 \times \mathbb{Z}_2$-flow.
